blogs.title: Mining Math from the Web
blogs.description: Discover how DeepSeekMath built an impressive 120 B‑token mathematical corpus by crawling the Common Crawl, classifying pages with fastText, and filtering out contamination—all without expensive proprietary data.

blogs.title: Code is a Secret Weapon for Math
blogs.description: Explore why pretraining on programming data gives language models a boost in plain‑text math reasoning, even when no external tools are used—why “code training” matters beyond just writing code.

blogs.title: Group Relative Policy Optimization – Reinforcement Learning Made Lean
blogs.description: Learn about GRPO, an efficient twist on PPO that drops the costly critic model, uses group baselines instead, and delivers stronger math reasoning while cutting memory usage.

blogs.title: Open‑Source Meets GPT‑4 on Mathematics
blogs.description: See how a tiny 7 B‑parameter model climbs to score >50% on the tough competition‑level MATH benchmark—nearly matching closed‑source giants—showing open‑source math LLMs are catching up fast.

blogs.title: Math Works In Every Language
blogs.description: Find out how incorporating multilingual content (English & Chinese) in training noticeably improves performance across both Western and East Asian math benchmarks—and why diversity matters.
